review_candidates.title: Telco Storage Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Telco Storage Engineer responsible for supporting, operating, implementing, and troubleshooting enterprise and telecom-grade storage infrastructure across service provider, Telco Cloud, data center, and large enterprise environments. The candidate should also have basic working knowledge of Telco network concepts to coordinate effectively with network teams during storage connectivity, service assurance, and infrastructure troubleshooting activities. Key Responsibil
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The role requires strong hands-on experience in Ceph storage, SAN, NAS, object storage, block storage, storage replication, backup storage integration, capacity management, performance tuning, and high-availability storage operations. Manage NAS services including file shares, NFS, SMB/CIFS, permissions, snapshots, quotas, and file-level access requirements. Coordinate with backup teams for storage availability, backup performance, retention requirements, and recovery readiness. Support data-at-rest encryption, access control, secure storage operations, and compliance requirements. Hands-on experience in Ceph storage administration including cluster health, OSD, MON, MGR, pools, placement groups, CRUSH map, RBD, CephFS, and RGW.
